summary: End-to-end verified that unused-file tidying (use-toast.js reducer refactor, index.js STALE_TIME_MS constant, server.py type hints) did not regress the Ready PH Portal. Root '/' redirects to /portal.html, admin/teacher flows, per-admin messaging, PWA gate emulation, static PWA assets, and backend GET /api/ all work. Static-only frontend so no pytest was written; backend sanity checked via curl.

issues: Tailwind CDN warns 'should not be used in production' (pre-existing, cosmetic console warning)

critical_code_review_comments: portal.html is a single 1297-line file; consider splitting into modules if it keeps growing (not required now).
server.py & React scaffold remain unused by the portal but boot fine; type hints look correct.
use-toast.js reducer switch has no default branch — safe but linter may flag; unused by app so cosmetic.
test_credentials: admin / readyph2026 (seeded by initDefaults on first load; /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty).
seed_data_creation: During Playwright test: created teacher 'jane' with Preschool+Elementary levels and Letters+Math subjects; created second admin 'admin2'; both localStorage-only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Ready PH Portal state lives in localStorage under keys: admin_accounts, teacher_accounts, messages, current session in state.session. Message shape uses fromType/fromUsername/toUsername/message/date/read and numeric id — required for checkNewMessages polling filter. To bypass the PWA install gate in headless Chromium: page.add_init_script overriding window.matchMedia so '(display-mode: standalone)' returns true BEFORE page.goto. All data-testids listed in the review_request work as expected.
